name: skill-pick
description: Names the 1 to 5 installed skills that fit each prompt, as many as the ask needs, with a small model and, when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set, a Jev score per skill; the log shows how often the main model then loads one. Default mode dry only measures. With a key set, the prompt and skill descriptions go to api.typesafe.ai (Jev) from every directory unless jevPaths limits it.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: off, dry (pick and log only) or on (the prompt gets one context line naming the picked skills).

model.title: Picker model
model.description: The small model that picks skills for each prompt.

minChars.title: Minimum length
minChars.description: Prompts shorter than this many characters are not judged.

maxSkills.title: Maximum skills
maxSkills.description: Ceiling on skills named per prompt, 1 to 5. The model picks how many the prompt needs.

picker.title: Picker
picker.description: auto (Jev first when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set, then the small model), haiku (small model only) or jev (Jev scores the skills and decides; the small model is still used in dry mode and when Jev is unavailable). With a key set, auto and jev send the prompt and the skill descriptions to api.typesafe.ai.

jevPaths.title: Jev directories
jevPaths.description: Comma-separated directory prefixes (~ allowed). Jev is used only when the working directory is under one. Empty means anywhere; a non-blank value with no usable entry means nowhere.
